documents.text: American Tragedy is the second studio album by American rap rock band Hollywood Undead. Production for the album began following the induction of Daniel Murillo into the band in early 2010 and lasted until December. The album is musically heavier and features darker lyrical content than the band's previous effort. Originally set to release in March, "American Tragedy" was released on April 5, 2011 in the United States and was released on various other dates that month in other countries. A remix of the album, "American Tragedy Redux", was released on November 21, 2011.
